text: Good morning, Central New Jersey. The weather service has a High Wind Warning for parts of the area, so check it before you head out. Watch for a closure at NJ 31 both directions : Malfunctioning traffic light (12.1 mi away). It's 50°F, Rain, up to 55°. Rain is likely around 3 PM, so bring an umbrella.

weatherAlerts.headline: High Wind Warning issued November 26 at 2:36PM EST until November 27 at 1:00AM EST by NWS Mount Holly NJ
weatherAlerts.instruction: People are urged to secure loose objects that could be blown around or damaged by the wind. Remain in the lower levels of your home during the windstorm, and avoid windows. Watch for falling debris and tree limbs. Use caution if you must drive.
